meta_description: Rent our penthouse in Rome with a magnificent terrace and panoramic view. Ideal for vacations or business stays in the quiet EUR neighborhood. Fast Wi-Fi, free parking, and all the comforts for an unforgettable experience.
meta_title: Panoramic Penthouse in Rome EUR | Luxury stay with terrace | Book now
section_description_text_1: Welcome to our cozy **penthouse with panoramic terrace in Rome**, located on the 7th floor of a quiet building in the heart of the EUR neighborhood. Bright and spacious, the accommodation is the ideal solution for those looking for a luxurious stay in a residential and safe area, away from the city chaos but just a few minutes from the main points of interest.
section_description_text_2: The penthouse is tastefully furnished and offers all the comforts to make your vacation or business trip unforgettable. Enjoy your morning coffee or an evening aperitif on our **spacious terrace**, with a breathtaking view of the rooftops of Rome and the green areas of the EUR neighborhood. The neighborhood is well connected to the historic center, Trastevere, and Fiumicino Airport by public transport, to explore the Eternal City with ease.
